captions.linkedin:
Every number needs a source, especially the big ones.

1976: my father opened the first Wiz on Fulton Street in Brooklyn. By 16, I had started four electronics and music stores.

Today's numbers are bigger. Per JemRock research, the global housing deficit is 155 million units, projected to reach 240 million by 2030. UN-Habitat counts 2.8 billion people without adequate housing. McKinsey (2019) found modular construction can be 20-50% faster, with cost savings of up to 20%, and losses of up to 10% if delivery or material costs spike. Our BUILT® design target is more than 50% faster: a target, not a result yet.

#Housing #ConstructionTech
